_about: Hand-written place, present state and recommended action for each gap the page lists, keyed by the candidate id from tools/washes/18_gaps.py. Written from the 2023 aerial photos and the county street and park layers; none of these places has been visited. 'short' is the place again in a line that fits the static map.

b4888858376.where: Interstate 10 between Twin Peaks Road and Avra Valley Road
b4888858376.short: I-10 between Twin Peaks Road and Avra Valley Road
b4888858376.now: Drainage culverts under the freeway and the railroad, in open desert beside the Santa Cruz River
b4888858376.action: A wildlife underpass under the freeway, frontage road and railroad together, with fencing to lead animals to it

b4901658180.where: Hardy Wash at Interstate 10, 800 m south-east of Twin Peaks Road
b4901658180.short: Hardy Wash at I-10, south-east of Twin Peaks Road
b4901658180.now: Culverts under the freeway and the railroad, between a shopping centre and a gravel pit
b4901658180.action: Enlarge the Hardy Wash culverts to a span an animal can walk through, and fence the approaches

b4930157875.where: Interstate 10, 900 m north-west of Ina Road
b4930157875.now: A culvert under the freeway and the railroad, with industrial yards on the west side
b4930157875.action: Enlarge the culvert to a walk-through span; the yards on the west side limit what it would reach

b4917657993.where: Interstate 10, 350 m south-east of Cortaro Road
b4917657993.now: A culvert under the freeway, with a shopping centre on the west side
b4917657993.action: Enlarge the culvert to a walk-through span; least promising of the freeway sites on the ground

b4955858696.where: Thornydale Road, 450 m south of Tangerine Road
b4955858696.short: Thornydale Road south of Tangerine Road
b4955858696.now: A two-lane road crossing the wash at grade, open desert on both sides
b4955858696.action: A box culvert large enough to walk through when the road is next widened; until then the crossing is at road level

b5033158231.where: Oracle Road by James D. Kriegh Park, 1.3 km north of Hardy Road
b5033158231.short: Oracle Road by James D. Kriegh Park
b5033158231.now: A culvert under the state route, desert on one side and playing fields on the other
b5033158231.action: Replace the culvert with a box large enough to walk through, with a dry floor

f4980858000.where: Cañada del Oro Wash between golf fairways, west of La Cholla Boulevard
f4980858000.short: Cañada del Oro between fairways, west of La Cholla Boulevard
f4980858000.now: Wide sandy bed with 13% tree canopy along it, fairways on both sides
f4980858000.action: Plant native bank trees (mesquite, desert willow) along 870 m so the trees on the two sides become one strip

f4947858224.where: Unnamed wash through the golf course by Arthur Pack Regional Park
f4947858224.short: Wash through the golf course by Arthur Pack Regional Park

f4947858224.action: Plant trees along 710 m of the wash, pond to pond

f4899858092.short: Santa Cruz side channel, Twin Peaks Road to Cortaro Road

f4899858092.action: Plant a line of trees along 960 m of the side channel, from the golf course to the river

f4976257102.where: Santa Cruz River between Sweetwater Wetlands and Silverbell Golf Course
f4976257102.short: Santa Cruz, Sweetwater Wetlands to Silverbell Golf Course

f4976257102.action: Plant the bank tops along 1.3 km to join the wetland's trees to the golf course's

f4989858534.short: Wash east of La Cholla Boulevard, south of Naranja Drive

q5045458482.short: Wash through apartments off La Reserve Drive
